Question B-001-015-010.

Why the correct answer is right: The bank gives 28.000 MHz to 29.700 MHz as the Canadian 10-metre amateur band range.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "24.890 MHz to 24.990 MHz": This is the 12-metre amateur band range, so it is below the 28 MHz start of 10 metres.
- sourceIndex 2: "21.000 MHz to 21.450 MHz": This is the 15-metre range named elsewhere in the bank, not 10 metres.
- sourceIndex 3: "50.000 MHz to 54.000 MHz": This is the 6-metre range rather than the 10-metre HF range.
